newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO sees 35-pct lower Q2 shr.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO sees 35-pct lower Q2 shr.

text.p: Energy marketer MAPCO Inc said Friday it expected second quarter earnings to be about 35 percent lower than the $0.31 per share earned for the same period a year ago.

MAPCO, which markets natural gas liquids and other fuels, said the drop was due to a series of special items, including the end of a franchise agreement, the lack of earnings following the sale of assets and expenses to support growth plans.
The company, which is to report earnings on July 23, said in a statement its was nevertheless reaffirming its strategic growth plans and 15-percent earnings-per-share growth target.
"The steps necessary to implement our growth strategy will result in lower earnings in the second quarter when compared to last year," it said.
